summary: Full end-to-end testing of Ziyma Systems landing page completed. Backend contact API (POST/GET /api/contact) and full frontend flows (navbar, hero CTA, work section, contact form submission, contact side links, mobile bottom-sheet menu) all pass.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend uses deprecated @app.on_event('shutdown'); consider migrating to lifespan context manager (non-blocking).
Contact form axios error handler is generic (single catch without inspecting response); consider showing 422 validation messages inline instead of a generic toast.
CORS_ORIGINS defaults to '*' with allow_credentials=True — combination is invalid per browsers and not recommended for production.
seed_data_creation: Created a few TEST_ prefixed contact inquiries in MongoDB via API/UI tests (non-destructive).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend contact endpoint validated at /api/contact (POST validates 422 for invalid email, name<2, message<5; GET returns list without _id). Frontend testids verified: hero-headline, hero-start-project-btn, main-navbar, nav-link-{studio,services,work,contact}, nav-cta-button, {studio,services,work,contact}-section, work-card-<slug> (4 cards), contact form inputs and submit, contact-{whatsapp,phone,email}-link, mobile-menu-toggle/sheet/close, mobile-nav-link-contact.
